pr_body:
This PR add to `IManagementGrain` the ability to query the `Catalog` for a given `IAddressable`.

Closes: #6809
pr_comments:
LGTM, except the last comment on the heterogenous cluster case. Let me know if you prefer me to fix it?

Do you want also to backport this to the future 3.4 release?

> Do you want also to backport this to the future 3.4 release?

I have a real use-case to use it as soon as possible, so if you have it on 3.4 would be perfect!

issue_context.title: Grain activation status
comments:
I am fine having such method on the `IManagementGrain` (we already have `IManagementGrain.GetGrainActivationCount` that could be used to see if the grain is activated?). 

How the `StatelessWorker` case will be handled though? 

I am a bit against adding the extension method to `IAddressable`, so it is not _too much_ discoverable. I understand that some scenario might need this information, but it should really be a corner case, and we don't want developer to rely on this information too much, as there is caveats as you noted.

Yeah, I'm ok with only having it exposed on `IManagementGrain` so it covers both internal and external scenarios anyway.

@ReubenBond ?

> How the StatelessWorker case will be handled though?

That would always return true in that case.

I am fine with `IManagementGrain` being used for both cases. It might lead to more bottlenecking than required, though - having a thin wrapper around the directory APIs (which can use the local cache) is more scalable.

I suggest we could also expose an interface for performing the lookups. An extension method is not the way to to.
